title: Luggage Limits on Safari Flights
excerpt: Light aircraft in Tanzania have strict luggage limits, usually in soft bags. What to pack and how to deal with extra gear.
body:
If you fly between parks or to Zanzibar, you will often travel in small aircraft. Space and weight are limited.

## Weight

Most domestic airlines allow around 15 to 20 kg per person, including hand luggage. Check the exact limit for your flights.

## Soft bags

Luggage must usually be soft (a duffel bag), without a hard frame or wheels, so it fits in the aircraft.

## Camera gear

Photographers with heavy gear can sometimes buy an extra seat. Ask in advance.

## Excess luggage

Climbing gear or extra luggage can often be stored at your hotel in Arusha or sent by road.

## Packing tips

- Pack light: laundry service is available in many lodges.
- See [seven safari packing mistakes](/blog/safari-packing-mistakes/).
